Project.NAME: frontend-livecoding-tasks
Project.keywords: frontend, live-coding, knowledge-base, markdown, javascript, typescript, react
Project.annotation: Knowledge base of frontend live-coding tasks maintained primarily as Markdown documents with JavaScript, TypeScript, and React examples; tasks are not expected to run from the repository by default.

M-GOVERNANCE.NAME: ProjectGovernance
M-GOVERNANCE.purpose: Define authoring, delivery, synchronization, verification, and stop-condition rules for the repository.

export-authoringRules.PURPOSE: Expose task authoring, worktree isolation, delivery, tool-resolution, and synchronization requirements

export-verificationContracts.PURPOSE: Expose shared completion evidence and phase gates

M-TASK-TEMPLATE.NAME: TaskTemplate
M-TASK-TEMPLATE.purpose: Define the canonical GitHub-rendered structure for self-contained frontend task cards.

type-TaskMetadata.PURPOSE: Exact labels and controlled values for technologies, topic, format, level, duration, skills, prerequisites, and execution environment

export-taskSchema.PURPOSE: Expose mandatory metadata, visible sections, progressive disclosure, and self-check structure

M-TASK-VALIDATION.NAME: TaskValidation
M-TASK-VALIDATION.purpose: Deduplicate and strictly validate independently authored candidates before publication.
M-TASK-VALIDATION.path: docs/task-validation-policy.md; Beads validation and wave-acceptance records

type-CandidateRegister.PURPOSE: Finite Beads inventory with stable candidate IDs and one validation decision per entry

export-validateCandidate.PURPOSE: Apply strict content, solution, evidence, and editorial gates

M-TASK-LIBRARY.NAME: TaskLibrary
M-TASK-LIBRARY.purpose: Store accepted, locally complete task cards and their canonical metadata.

type-TaskMetadataSet.PURPOSE: Collection of canonical task metadata records exposed to the catalog

export-taskCard.PURPOSE: Expose the complete student-facing exercise through GitHub

M-CATALOG.NAME: StudentCatalog
M-CATALOG.purpose: Provide the student entry point and thematic, agent-synchronized projections of canonical task metadata.

export-studentIndex.PURPOSE: Expose thematic tables with exactly one row per task and all catalog metadata
